LanguageData.LP_MimicChest.label: gilded treasure chest
LanguageData.LP_MimicChest.description: An old gilded chest with dust on its lid. It may be full of treasure, or it may be a mimic. Right-click to open, or have someone with Intellectual ≥8 appraise it first.
LanguageData.LP_HeartTree.label: heart of the forest
LanguageData.LP_HeartTree.description: A small silver-leaved tree planted by a treant, with faint light flowing in its trunk. Crops within 8 cells grow 20% faster. Cannot be cut down or deconstructed.
LanguageData.LP_SilverDragonScale.label: silver dragon scale
LanguageData.LP_SilverDragonScale.description: A scale left behind by a silver dragon's avatar when it departed: cold, light and nearly impenetrable. Can be used as a cold-resistant armor material.
LanguageData.LP_MimicTooth.label: mimic fang
LanguageData.LP_MimicTooth.description: A mimic's hook-like fang, still with wood grain on it. Alchemists and collectors both want it.
LanguageData.LP_StarHeart.label: heart of a fallen star
LanguageData.LP_StarHeart.description: A star core wrapped in a mithril meteorite, always glowing faintly. Legendary weapons are said to be forged from such things; collectors and the Black Network will pay a high price.
LanguageData.LP_AdventureLog.label: adventure journal
LanguageData.LP_AdventureLog.description: The journal of an adventuring party that was wiped out, recording their experience and lessons along the way. Reading it grants 400 adventurer XP (can only be read once).
LanguageData.LP_TourneyTrophy.label: tournament trophy
LanguageData.LP_TourneyTrophy.description: A gilded trophy from the tournament of Faerûn's pioneer league, engraved with the event and the winner's name. Looks nice in a room.
LanguageData.LP_TarrasqueShell.label: Tarrasque carapace
LanguageData.LP_TarrasqueShell.description: Carapace stripped from the Tarrasque's back, thicker than steel and tougher than plasteel. The best material for armor and walls.
LanguageData.LP_TarrasqueTooth.label: Tarrasque fang
LanguageData.LP_TarrasqueTooth.description: A Tarrasque fang, an arm long and sharp enough to slice through city gates. The best material for melee weapons.
LanguageData.LP_Mimic.label: mimic
LanguageData.LP_Mimic.description: A monster that disguises itself as a treasure chest. The lid is its mouth, ringed with wood-grain fangs, with a long, sticky tongue. Its belly often still holds the previous adventurer's belongings.
LanguageData.LP_Treant.label: treant
LanguageData.LP_Treant.description: An awakened ancient tree with bark like armor and branches like fists. Walks very slowly but is strong enough to push down city walls. Fears fire.
LanguageData.LP_Tarrasque.label: Tarrasque
LanguageData.LP_Tarrasque.description: The legendary doomsday beast: a mountain-sized body, a reflective carapace and a mouth that can bite through city gates. It sleeps underground for centuries and, when it wakes, eats its way to the sea. Its wounds heal very fast, and it destroys whatever it runs into.
